requirement:
Expanding or collapsing a directory group changes visibility without
changing the files or documented annotations represented by the overview.
rationale:
**Obligation.** `requirements.test-coverage.index.file_map.directories.data` says that expanding or collapsing a directory group only changes visibility. The files and documented annotations the overview represents must stay the same. **How the implementation toggles.** In `src/execution_coverage/book.rs#fn[gaps_map]` and `impl[GapDirectory<'_>]/fn[render]`, each directory group is a native `
` element. Its `` carries the path and the documented-item count. All descendant file rows and nested groups are emitted into the markup inside the element. No script handles directory toggling. The browser toggles `open`, so the data cannot change. The page must therefore contain every file and annotation in every group, whatever the open state. **Test mapping.** `documented_items_are_counted_once_with_browsable_directory_and_file_groups` is marked `{test}` for the subject. It checks the following: - **Count of represented items.** The total reads "7 documented source items carrying coverage annotations". - **Per-group counts.** For `src`, `src/deep`, `vendor`, `docs_only` and `docs_only/deep`, the helper `directory_group` extracts the full group by balancing nested `
` tags. The test asserts the opening tag is `
`. It also asserts the summary shows the expected number of documented source items. - **Group membership.** `assert_directory_contents` checks which child directories and files sit inside each group. Examples: `src` holds `src/deep` and `src/direct.rs`; `docs_only` holds only the nested `docs_only/deep`; `docs_only/deep` holds `item.rs`. A separate assertion confirms the ancestor `docs_only` contains no `data-file=` rows of its own. - **Root files.** Root file `code.rs` is outside any `
` and has no `hidden` attribute, so visibility changes cannot affect it. - **Per-file annotations.** For each of `code.rs`, `src/direct.rs` and `src/deep/nested.rs`, the file card carries the annotation count, the note links, the explanations, and the `file:line #selector` locations. The corresponding generated note chapters exist. - **Absent items.** `src/pass.rs`, which has no annotations, is not listed. **Collapsed state.** A collapsed state cannot be driven without a browser. Native `
` makes it purely presentational, and the test shows that the full file and annotation data is present inside the `open` groups. An implementation that rendered files lazily, dropped rows, or changed counts when a group is closed would fail these assertions. The test also checks that nothing outside the file-detail rows is hidden. **Conclusion.** I found no untested obligation, no marking gap, and no applicable `{fixme}`.

text: Expanding or collapsing a directory group changes visibility without
changing the files or documented annotations represented by the overview.
The overview groups its listed files by directory hierarchy. Every
non-root directory containing a listed file, directly or through descendants,
has an independently expandable group. A collapsed group shows its
workspace-relative path and the number of documented source items carrying
coverage annotations in its descendants, while hiding their file rows.

Directory groups in the documented coverage overview are expanded
initially. Files at the workspace root remain visible.
